info.text:
# Jet Set Radio Future

## What does randomization do to this game?

You play the city as it is after the story: the free-skate chapter, with the Garage as your hub. Each area stays locked
until its Unlock item arrives. You start with one area (Dogenzaka Hill unless you choose another) and one character
(Beat unless you choose another). Everything else you need comes from the multiworld.

If you skate into an area you don't have yet, Corn stops you and the client sends you back to the Garage.

## What counts as a check?

| Check | How many | Option |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Graffiti Souls lying in the levels | 40 | always on |
| Graffiti Souls from Street Challenges | 65 | Include Street Challenges |
| Mystery Tapes | 13 | Include Mystery Tapes |
| Beating a rival gang: Doom Riders, Love Shockers, Immortals | 3 | Include Rival Gang Battles |
| Recruiting Rhyth, Boogie, Cube, Jazz and Soda | 5 | Character Unlock Checks: Recruits |
| The characters Roboy's Test Runs hand out | 12 more | Character Unlock Checks: All |
| A Jet rank on each of Roboy's Test Runs | 39 | Include Jet Ranks |
| Graffiti tag spots, save point tags included | 573 | Include Graffiti Tags (off by default) |

## Which items are in the pool?

- An Unlock item for every area except your starting one.
- Every character except the one you start with. Characters never block progress.
- Mystery Tape items, one per area (with Include Mystery Tapes on). An area's Street Challenges only open once you have
  its Mystery Tape item, your starting area's included.
- Graffiti Soul items, which count toward Gouji's Tower. These are items, separate from the souls you pick up in the
  levels.
- Gouji's Tower Unlock.
- Filler: Spray Can Refill and Health Refill, which top up your cans or health the moment they arrive.

## What is the goal?

The Goal option has two choices.

**Defeat Gouji.** Gouji's Tower opens once you have the Gouji's Tower Unlock and enough Graffiti Soul items (Tower:
Graffiti Souls Needed). You can also require sprayed tag spots and cleared Street Challenges. When the Tower is open,
talk to Corn in the Garage and say Yes. Beat the final boss to finish.

**Jet Ranks.** Earn a Jet rank on as many Test Runs as Jet Ranks Needed asks for. As in the normal game, Roboy in the
Garage offers an area's three Test Runs once you hold every Graffiti Soul of that area, Street Challenge souls included.
In a Jet Ranks seed Gouji's Tower is optional.

## What does another world's item look like in this game?

Items have no shape in the game itself. When you collect a check, the client window shows what you found and who it
belongs to. Items you receive appear as a notice over the game screen.

tutorials.text:
# Jet Set Radio Future Setup Guide

## Required software

- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest) 0.6.8 or newer.
- JSRF Unleashed 0.6.10 on Windows, set up with your own copy of Jet Set Radio Future. Make sure the game runs on its
  own before you go on.
- `jsrf.apworld`, release v1.0a.

The client only works on Windows, because it reads and writes the running game's memory.

## Installing the world

1. Close the Archipelago Launcher if it is open.
2. Copy `jsrf.apworld` into the `custom_worlds` folder of your Archipelago install, for example
   `C:\ProgramData\Archipelago\custom_worlds`. **Install APWorld** in the Launcher does the same.
3. Open the Launcher. **Jet Set Radio Future Client** is now in its list.

## Making your options file

Open **Options Creator** in the Launcher and pick Jet Set Radio Future, or use the player options page. The options are
grouped as on that page:

- **Goal:** Defeat Gouji, or Jet Ranks (with how many Jets you need).
- **Gouji's Tower:** what opens the Tower: Graffiti Soul items, and optionally tag spots and Street Challenges.
- **Starting Out:** your starting area and starting character. Tick **Random?** for a random pick.
- **Checks:** which kinds of checks are in the seed (see the game page for the full list).

Then generate the game the usual Archipelago way, or give the file to whoever hosts.

## Joining a game

1. Start JSRF Unleashed.
2. In the Launcher, open **Jet Set Radio Future Client**. Enter the server address (for example `archipelago.gg:38281`)
   and connect, then enter your slot name.
3. Wait for **Found the game.** in the client window. Keep the client running the whole time you play, and start it
   before you skate into any area.
4. Start a **New Game**. Corn tells you which area is open, then the client takes you to the free-skate Garage. The
   client ties this save to your seed and says **This save is now tied to this seed.**

To keep playing later, start the game and the client again and load the same save.

A save from another seed is left alone: the client sends nothing from it. If you started this seed's New Game while the
client was closed, load that save and type `/usesave`.

## Playing

- The Garage is your hub. Use its doors to reach the areas you have unlocked.
- An area's Street Challenges open when you have its Mystery Tape item. You can still pick up the tape lying in the
  level: that is a check of its own.
- Roboy offers an area's Test Runs once you hold every Graffiti Soul of that area. After a Test Run, the client takes you
  back to the free-skate Garage through the character select.
- When Gouji's Tower is open, talk to Corn in the Garage. Say Yes to go, or No to come back to it later.

## Client commands

| Command | What it shows or does |
| --- | --- |
| `/goal` | Your goal and how far along you are. |
| `/unlocks` | Which areas are open, and how many checks are held for areas still locked. |
| `/tapes` | Which Mystery Tape items you have. |
| `/checks` | Whether the loaded save is tied to this seed, and how many checks of each kind are done. |
| `/usesave` | Ties the loaded save to this seed. |

Archipelago's own commands work too, such as `/received`, `/missing` and `/help`.

## Troubleshooting

- **"jsrf_recomp.exe is not running. Start the game first."** Start JSRF Unleashed. The client finds it by itself.
- **"Found the game, but without write access"**: Windows kept the client from changing the game. Start the game and the
  Launcher the same way: both normally, or both as administrator.
- **"This seed was made with JSRF v…, but this client is v…"**: install the `jsrf.apworld` the seed was made with, or
  generate a new seed.
- **Something else went wrong:** send these two files with your report: the newest `JSRFClient_*.txt` in Archipelago's
  `logs` folder, and `last-run.log` in your JSRF Unleashed folder.

readme.text:
# Jet Set Radio Future for Archipelago

An [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) world and client for Jet Set Radio Future, played on JSRF Unleashed for Windows.

**Current release: v1.4a (alpha).**

## What it does

You skate the city as it is after the story, with the Garage as your hub. Every area stays locked until its Unlock item
arrives, and what you find in the city is sent out to the multiworld.

**Checks**

| Check | How many |
| --- | --- |
| Graffiti Souls lying in the levels | 40 |
| Graffiti Souls from Street Challenges | 65 |
| Mystery Tapes | 13 |
| Rival gang battles (Doom Riders, Love Shockers, Immortals) | 3 |
| Recruited characters (Rhyth, Boogie, Cube, Jazz, Soda) | 5, or 17 with the Test Run characters |
| Jet ranks on Roboy's Test Runs | 39 |
| Graffiti tag spots (off by default) | 573 |

**Items:** an Unlock item for each area, every character, Mystery Tape items (an area's Street Challenges open with its
tape), Graffiti Soul items, Gouji's Tower Unlock, and Spray Can / Health refills as filler.

**Goals:** defeat Gouji in Gouji's Tower, or earn a set number of Jet ranks on Roboy's Test Runs.

The client runs beside the game. It sends your checks, hands you your items, turns you back from areas you haven't
unlocked, has Corn tell you what's going on, and shows the items you receive on the game screen.

## Requirements

- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest) 0.6.8 or newer
- JSRF Unleashed 0.6.10 on Windows, set up with your own copy of Jet Set Radio Future

## Installing

1. Download `jsrf.apworld` from this repository's **Releases** page.
2. Put it in the `custom_worlds` folder of your Archipelago install, or use **Install APWorld** in the Archipelago
   Launcher.
3. Follow the [setup guide](jsrf/docs/setup_en.md) to make your options file and connect.

The [game page](<jsrf/docs/en_Jet Set Radio Future.md>) explains the checks, items and goals in more detail.
[`Jet Set Radio Future.yaml`](<Jet Set Radio Future.yaml>) is an example options file with every option at its
default; the Options Creator in the Launcher makes the same file.

## Client commands

| Command | What it shows or does |
| --- | --- |
| `/goal` | Your goal and how far along you are |
| `/unlocks` | Which areas are open, and checks held for areas still locked |
| `/tapes` | Which Mystery Tape items you have |
| `/checks` | Whether the loaded save is tied to your seed, and how many checks of each kind are done |
| `/usesave` | Ties the loaded save to your seed |

## Building from source

With Python 3 installed, run:

```
python build_apworld.py
```

The finished world is written to `dist/jsrf.apworld`.

## Reporting a problem

Open an issue and attach two files: the newest `JSRFClient_*.txt` from Archipelago's `logs` folder, and `last-run.log`
from your JSRF Unleashed folder.

## Legal

This is a fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by SEGA. Jet Set Radio Future and its characters belong to SEGA.
JSRF Unleashed is a separate project by its own authors. No game files are included: the client reads what it needs from
your own copy of the game while it runs.

The code is released under the MIT License (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)).

notes.text:
## Bug fixes

- **No more false "Stage ... is not mapped to an area yet" messages.** While a level was loading, for example on the way into 99th Street, the client could read leftover data from the game's memory as a stage. It then asked you to report an area that doesn't exist.
- **Readings that aren't a real stage are now ignored.** Every stage the game uses has the same simple format, and anything else counts as "still loading", so it can't trigger the message or anything else.
- **The message only appears if the same unknown stage shows up twice in a row.** A brief wrong reading while loading never shows up, but a genuinely unknown area would still be reported.
- **Nothing else was affected.** The wrong reading never held, sent or blocked any checks, and it never sent you back to the Garage.

To update, replace `jsrf.apworld` in your `custom_worlds` folder and restart the client. Existing seeds keep working.
